title: About us
text:
JuliaBayes is a shared home for Bayesian software in Julia. Our goal is to make it easier to collaborate, share maintenance, and keep packages supported over time.
We are an open and welcoming community of people interested in Bayesian statistics, whether in theory, in applications, or in software engineering. Our projects span modelling, inference, and tools for working with the results.
We welcome collaboration across probabilistic programming languages, research groups, and institutions. Most of us contribute alongside our day jobs, so contributions of all sizes are welcome.
Want to bring your package into JuliaBayes, or just talk Bayes with us? Come say hello in #bayes on the Julia Slack (join here if you are not on it yet)!
